be_rule: both primary parameters: 90% CI of the T/R geometric mean ratio within 80.00% to 125.00%, judged on unrounded limits
model: ln(AVAL) ~ sequence + participant(sequence) + period + formulation (fixed effects, GLM)

nca.time_variable: ARRLT (actual time from the period's dose); pre-dose samples set to time 0
nca.lambda_z_selection: largest number of points whose adjusted R-squared is within 1e-4 of the best (PKNCA default)
nca.zero_segment: linear trapezoid for a segment that starts or ends at a zero (BLQ) concentration; log-down only when both concentrations are positive
nca.min_hl_adj_r_squared_rule: lambda z, t1/2, AUC(0-inf) and the extrapolated percentage are not summarized or analyzed when the adjusted R-squared of the terminal fit is below 0.90
nca.max_aucinf_pext_rule: AUC(0-inf) is not summarized or analyzed when more than 20% of it is extrapolated; the extrapolated percentage itself is still summarized

exclusion_rules.emesis_rule: period excluded if emesis occurs within 2 h of dosing (twice the expected median tmax of 1 h); a protocol violation documented when it happens, before bioanalysis (ICH M13A 2.2.1)
exclusion_rules.predose_rule: period excluded if the pre-dose concentration is above 5% of that period's Cmax; applied to the bioanalytical results (ICH M13A 2.2.3.3)
exclusion_rules.low_exposure_rule: period may be excluded if its AUC is below 5% of the product's geometric mean AUC calculated without the participant, at most 1 participant expected; applied to the bioanalytical results (ICH M13A 2.2.1.1)
exclusion_rules.first_point_cmax_rule: participants whose Cmax is at the first post-dose sample in either period are removed in a supplementary analysis; the primary analysis keeps them (ICH M13A 2.1.8.1)
